hook.en: A Grab fare depends on distance. Your exam grade depends on your mark. A function is a rule that turns each input into exactly one output — and if you can reverse the rule, you can work backwards from the answer.
hook.bm: Tambang Grab bergantung pada jarak. Gred peperiksaan bergantung pada markah. Fungsi ialah petua yang menukar setiap input kepada tepat satu output — dan jika petua itu boleh diterbalikkan, anda boleh bekerja ke belakang dari jawapan.

bigIdeas.en: A function maps every object to exactly one image.
bigIdeas.bm: Fungsi memetakan setiap objek kepada tepat satu imej.

bigIdeas.en: Domain = set of objects; range = set of images actually produced.
bigIdeas.bm: Domain = set objek; julat = set imej yang dihasilkan.

bigIdeas.en: Composite function fg(x) = f(g(x)) — apply g first, then f.
bigIdeas.bm: Fungsi gubahan fg(x) = f(g(x)) — guna g dahulu, kemudian f.

bigIdeas.en: Only one-to-one functions have an inverse f⁻¹, which undoes f.
bigIdeas.bm: Hanya fungsi satu dengan satu mempunyai songsangan f⁻¹, yang membatalkan f.

bigIdeas.en: The graph of f⁻¹ is the reflection of f in the line y = x.
bigIdeas.bm: Graf f⁻¹ ialah pantulan graf f pada garis y = x.

definition.en: A relation where each object has exactly one image.
definition.bm: Hubungan dengan setiap objek mempunyai tepat satu imej.

definition.en: Input x and its output f(x).
f⁻¹ maps each image back to its object.
definition.bm: f⁻¹ memetakan setiap imej kembali kepada objeknya.

definition.en: |x| is the distance of x from 0, always ≥ 0.

question.en: Given f(x) = 2x + 3, find f⁻¹(x) and check that ff⁻¹(5) = 5.
question.bm: Diberi f(x) = 2x + 3, cari f⁻¹(x) dan semak ff⁻¹(5) = 5.

prompt.en: Which type of relation is NOT a function?

explanation.en: In a one-to-many relation an object has more than one image — not allowed in a function.
explanation.bm: Dalam hubungan satu dengan banyak, satu objek mempunyai lebih daripada satu imej — tidak dibenarkan dalam fungsi.

prompt.en: Given f(x) = 4x − 5, find the object whose image is 7.
prompt.bm: Diberi f(x) = 4x − 5, cari objek yang imejnya 7.

prompt.en: f(x) = (x + 1)/(x − 2). Which value of x must be excluded from the domain?
prompt.bm: f(x) = (x + 1)/(x − 2). Nilai x manakah mesti dikecualikan daripada domain?

explanation.en: x = 2 makes the denominator zero, so f(2) is undefined.
explanation.bm: x = 2 menjadikan penyebut sifar, jadi f(2) tidak tertakrif.

prompt.en: f(x) = 3x − 1 and g(x) = x². Find fg(2).
prompt.bm: f(x) = 3x − 1 dan g(x) = x². Cari fg(2).

explanation.en: g(2) = 4, then f(4) = 3(4) − 1 = 11. Apply g first!
explanation.bm: g(2) = 4, kemudian f(4) = 3(4) − 1 = 11. Guna g dahulu!

prompt.en: f(x) = 3x − 1 and g(x) = x². Find gf(2).
prompt.bm: f(x) = 3x − 1 dan g(x) = x². Cari gf(2).

explanation.en: f(2) = 5, then g(5) = 25. Note fg ≠ gf in general.
explanation.bm: f(2) = 5, kemudian g(5) = 25. Perhatikan fg ≠ gf secara umum.

prompt.en: f(x) = x + 2 and fg(x) = 3x. Find g(x).
prompt.bm: f(x) = x + 2 dan fg(x) = 3x. Cari g(x).

prompt.en: The graph of y = f⁻¹(x) is the reflection of y = f(x) in the line…
prompt.bm: Graf y = f⁻¹(x) ialah pantulan graf y = f(x) pada garis…

explanation.en: Swapping x and y reflects a graph in y = x.
explanation.bm: Menukar x dan y memantulkan graf pada y = x.

prompt.en: Why does f(x) = x² (for all real x) have no inverse function?
prompt.bm: Mengapa f(x) = x² (untuk semua x nyata) tiada fungsi songsang?

options.en: It is not one-to-one: f(2) = f(−2) = 4
options.bm: Ia bukan satu dengan satu: f(2) = f(−2) = 4

options.en: Its range is all real numbers

explanation.en: It fails the horizontal line test. Restricting the domain to x ≥ 0 makes it one-to-one.
explanation.bm: Ia gagal ujian garis mengufuk. Mengehadkan domain kepada x ≥ 0 menjadikannya satu dengan satu.
